contract.intended_consumer: Brian and his coding agents running make reachability-check in any governed repo
contract.outcome: The shared reachability sensor fails --check when the share of lines reachable from the declared product entrypoint regresses against its recorded baseline, so code reachable only from tests and scripts stops passing as clean.

canonical_journey.starting_state: A governed repo whose reachability_baseline.json records product_share, with a module reachable only from its own test file added since that baseline.
canonical_journey.input: One reachability baseline carrying product_share and one working tree whose product path has regressed against it.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Exit code 1 naming the fall from the baseline share to the current share; an unchanged tree exits 0; a baseline with no product_share key exits 0.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: --check returns 0 while product_share sits below the baseline, or returns 1 on a baseline that has no product_share key.

progress_dimensions: backward compatibility with baselines predating product_share
